answers.explanation: Jim took out a book and pretended to do the same as the girl, so on the train he was pretending to read.

That evening the call came from Umaru, Jim's colleague, since the passage says it was only Umaru who rang.
Jim asked her to ring at nine, and she rang the next morning at two minutes past nine, so the misunderstanding came from the time he gave.

The Chinese kept their silkworms a closely guarded secret, meaning carefully hidden from the knowledge of others.
